title: CrowdSec Security (Placeholder - Create custom dashboard)
description:
This is a placeholder dashboard. To enable:
1. Check if CrowdSec exposes Prometheus metrics endpoint
2. Uncomment crowdsec job in prometheus.yml.j2 if metrics available
3. Create custom dashboard using CrowdSec metrics
4. Recommended metrics (if available):
   - Threats blocked: crowdsec_threats_blocked_total
   - IPs banned: crowdsec_ips_banned_total
   - Decision rates: crowdsec_decisions_*
